jobs.prompt: Create ONE BrineSpace L-shaped corner counter for a SQUARE TOP-DOWN ROOM. Attached straight counter is STYLE and CAMERA reference. Critical layout: counter occupies the TOP and LEFT edges of a square room: long straight outer back across screen HORIZONTALLY and long straight outer left back down screen VERTICALLY. The L's outside bounding edges meet at an exact screen-space 90-degree upper-left corner. No diagonal/isometric footprint, no diamond, no rotated room axes. Broad horizontal top wing across upper part, perpendicular vertical left wing down left part. Open concave empty floor area is lower-right. Keep floor-plan lines screen aligned while showing shallow downward front-face thickness like supplied counter. Two rectangular wings of equal worktop depth, continuous L worktop, closed supported cabinets below. Back edges have no projecting feet, trims or accessories so they abut square room walls. Matte gray top and charcoal drawer cabinets; a small tool tray, two couplings and a closed olive parts case on top. Accessories completely inside top footprint, spare clear workspace. Match matte painted industrial finish, restrained detail and generic neutral palette. Intended export about 345x285 library pixels. True transparent background and transparent empty inner corner. Full silhouette, no walls, floor, shadows outside object, text, people, glow or glossy finish.
